rows.notes: The document is explicitly labelled 'TYPE Review' (Frontiers in Plant Science 2024). It is a literature review of UAV remote sensing and deep learning for crop disease and pest detection, built on a bibliometric keyword/author/country co-occurrence analysis of 13738 WOS papers (Section 2) and narrative summaries of other studies' results (Sections 5-7). The only quasi-original element is an informal trial of GPT-4 on two apple-scab leaf images (Figure 9), which is a demonstration, not an experiment on the claimed effect. It reports no own field, survey or model data on UAV/remote-sensing systems improving disease diagnostics, optimizing treatment, or supporting targeted agrochemical application; such statements (e.g. Section 3.3 on reducing insecticide use and enabling preventive measures) are assertions or citations of other work.
